_about: Named voices this brand may use. A maker asks for a voice by name in job.json ("voice": "Name"); tools/audio/voice.mjs looks up its ElevenLabs id here. Add a voice by saving it on the team's ElevenLabs account, then adding a row to "voices". "default" is the voice used when a job names none.

_example_row.library_name: Its full name in the ElevenLabs library
